title: Phase 3 Decision Brief Contract
description: TARGET CONTRACT ONLY. NOT IMPLEMENTED as of 2026-10-26: no /gate or /brief endpoint, no scoreVersion, and no Phase 3 tests exist in the repository. One object per horizon; a Brief must contain both short and medium.

horizon.description: Analysis horizon. short = up to 24h; medium = 7 to 30 days. A single ambiguous value is forbidden.

scoreVersion.description: Version of the score weights/formula used for this Brief. Any weight change must bump this value and add a test.

statusBullets.description: Two to four status bullets. Descriptive only; no imperative buy/sell language.

keyNumbers.description: Motor-derived numbers only. Every displayed number must also carry unit/asOf/source/quality in the UI.

bubble_pct.description: Bubble as a percentage of fair value; null when unavailable.

score.description: Weighted score 0-100; null when coverage is insufficient.

implied_usd.description: Implied USD from the model; null when unavailable.

risks.description: Fixed risk codes, e.g. data_stale, extreme_retail_premium, implied_conflict, insufficient_coverage, low_liquidity.

checklist.description: Verification steps only. No action/order instructions.

status.description: Gate status. red must force actionLanguageAllowed=false.

actionLanguageAllowed.description: Must be false when status is red.

value.description: Total score 0-100; null when coverage is insufficient.

weight.description: Component weight; the sum of all weights must equal 1.

value.description: Component score contribution; null when unavailable.

weightsSum.description: Sum of component weights; must equal 1 (tolerance 1e-9) or validation fails.

disclaimer.description: Fixed Persian disclaimer from docs/phase3-disclaimer-fa.md. No target price, no profit promise.
